MOZ.note: A digital identity workshop and a stated aim to accelerate digital identity; no authentication service is stated as piloted or in use.
No link between civil register and ID system is stated.
The Citizen Portal is named only as a priority to accelerate, with services still to be chosen; no service is stated online.
No count or share of people holding a national ID is stated.
No number at birth is mentioned.
Who operates or owns the ID system is not stated.
Data sharing is a stated aim only; no register keyed on the ID number is stated.
No national ID system is described as procured, piloted or in service.
